dse_runs.notes: Area-dominated spec: minimise luts_plus_ffs, hard constraint throughput_msps>=1 and max_abs_err<=2^-10 (10 bits). Small data widths and lower unroll are likely attractive but must still meet 1 MSPS and 10-bit accuracy; keep the front well spread on the accuracy axis too.

selected_facts.dds_provenance: simulated (hw_dse.l2.dds l2-v1: golden-model DDS, 32-bit phase accumulator, coherent 16384-point FFT, tone bin 1297)

l2.reason: the spec has no system scenario: nothing to re-select

final_text: Campaign complete — the queue held a single spec, `low_area_control` (min luts_plus_ffs, throughput >= 1 MSPS, max_abs_err <= 2^-10), and it is finalized. I spent the full 400-eval L1 budget in one structured `run_dse` pass, which produced a 36-design feasible, non-dominated Pareto front (37% of the front's designs are in the area/accuracy trade zone) and whose inner architect stopped after `add_family -> map_front -> map_front -> stop`; the front's best designs were all `iterative`-family. L2 `simulate_system` was a no-op for selection because this spec has no system scenario (it still returned a DDS SFDR/SNR fact and confirmed the selection). The `ladder` sub-agent then ran L3 `verify_rtl`, L4 `synthesize` and L5 `back_annotate`: all three returned "no recorded/measured data for this selection" (`no_measured_data`), no WINNER CHANGE was flagged, so `reexplore` was correctly not called and no re-run was needed. Final selection by the spec's rule (min luts_plus_ffs): `iterative:data_width=15,n_iter=16,angle_guard=1,frac_guard=0,rounding=round` — luts_plus_ffs=260 (estimate, luts=168, ffs=92), accuracy_bits=10.6, max_abs_err=0.000632 exact (2^-10.63, satisfying the <=2^-10 constraint), throughput 10.4 MSPS (estimate, comfortably above the 1 MSPS constraint), recorded via `finalize` with the full provenance chain. Provenance note: LUT/FF/throughput figures are cost-model estimates (M1 calibration), errors are exact from the golden model, and no measured L3/L4/L5 numbers exist for this design — nothing was estimated or invented by me. Memory storage was refused (memory switched off this campaign), so the lessons are reported here only.
